item.description:
✖️ The Hustle

This company is arming farmers with lasers.

@carbon_robotics trained its Large Plant Model on more than 150 million labeled plant images.

As plants pass underneath the LaserWeeder, cameras capture them and the AI decides what’s a crop and what’s a weed.

The system can even adapt to new plants it hasn’t encountered before and learn whether to protect them or target them.
